name: Weakened Floor
disable: DC 20 Survival check to knock loose the unstable floor and reveal a traversable ledge to the south.

items.name: Floor Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A Small or larger creature enters the marked portion of the map

---

Effect The triggering creature falls, taking 20 damage from the fall plus 3d6 piercing damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save) from the stalagmites. A creature can Grab an Edge to avoid falling, or succeed at a DC 20 Athletics check check to climb out of the chasm.

text: A section of the cave floor collapses under a creature, plunging it 40 feet into a chasm filled with jagged stalactites.
